lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa and her family are going out for the day.
lines.zh: 佩奇一家今天要出去玩。

lines.en: Peppa, George, today we're going to Windy Castle. What's Windy Castle, Daddy? It's a castle on a very high hill. George likes castles.
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，今天我们要去风车城堡。爸爸，风车城堡是什么？它是一座建在高高山上的城堡。乔治喜欢城堡。

lines.en: Windy Castle sounds like a boring place for boys.
lines.zh: 风车城堡听起来是个很无聊的地方，只有男孩子才喜欢。

lines.en: No, Peppa, you'll love it. There's a great view from the top of Windy Castle. You can even see Granny and Grandpa's house. Wow, let's go!
lines.zh: 不，佩奇，你会喜欢的。从风车城堡顶上看出去风景特别好。你甚至能看到爷爷奶奶家。哇，那我们快走吧！

lines.en: I'll map read, and Mummy Pig will drive. Are you sure, Daddy Pig? When you map read, we always get lost, and you get grumpy. We will not get lost, and I will not get grumpy.
lines.zh: 我来看地图，猪妈妈开车。猪爸爸，你确定吗？每次你看地图我们都会迷路，然后你就会发脾气。我们不会迷路的，我也不会发脾气。

lines.en: Windy Castle, here we come!
lines.zh: 风车城堡，我们来啦！

lines.en: Are we really there yet? Not quite. Oh, would you like to play a game? Yes, please. Let's play I Spy. Okay, I'll go first.
lines.zh: 我们真的到了吗？还没到。哦，你们想玩个游戏吗？想！我们玩「我看见了」吧。好的，我先来。

lines.en: Daddy Pig has to secretly look at something, and the others have to guess what it is. I spy with my little eye something colored red. Red?
lines.zh: 猪爸爸要偷偷看着一样东西，其他人来猜那是什么。我用我的小眼睛看见了，一样红色的东西。红色的？

lines.en: My dress! That's red! No, it's not your dress. Hmm.
lines.zh: 我的裙子！那是红色的！不对，不是你的裙子。嗯。

lines.en: The car! That's right, our red car.
lines.zh: 是车！答对了，我们的红色汽车。

lines.en: Go. I spy with my little eye something blue.
lines.zh: 轮到你了。我用我的小眼睛看见了，一样蓝色的东西。

lines.en: Hmm, George's blue shirt? Nope. Is it something in the car? No. Give up? Yes. The sky! The blue sky!
lines.zh: 嗯，是乔治的蓝衬衫吗？不是。是车里的东西吗？不是。放弃了吗？放弃了。是天空！蓝色的天空！

lines.en: I win! Daddy Pig, do you know where we are? I know exactly where we are. Although this road doesn't look the same as it does on the map.
lines.zh: 我赢啦！猪爸爸，你知道我们在哪儿吗？我完全知道我们在哪儿。虽然这条路看起来和地图上不太一样。

lines.en: Oh, Daddy Pig! We're lost! We are not lost! So how do we get to Windy Castle from here? Just give me a moment. Hmm.
lines.zh: 哦，猪爸爸！我们迷路了！我们没有迷路！那从这里怎么去风车城堡？给我一点时间。嗯。

lines.en: I know, we can ring Granny and Grandpa. There's no need to ring Granny and Grandpa. I'll get us to Windy Castle if it takes me all day. We haven't got all day.
lines.zh: 我知道了，我们可以给爷爷奶奶打电话。没必要给爷爷奶奶打电话。就算花一整天，我也能带你们到风车城堡。我们可没有一整天的时间。

lines.en: Hello, Grandpa Pig speaking. Grandpa Pig, we've got a bit lost on the way to Windy Castle.
lines.zh: 喂，我是猪爷爷。猪爷爷，我们在去风车城堡的路上有点迷路了。

lines.en: Is Daddy Pig doing the map reading? Yes, Daddy Pig is doing the map reading, and he's a bit grumpy at the moment. I am not grumpy.
lines.zh: 是猪爸爸在看地图吗？是的，猪爸爸在看地图，而且他这会儿有点暴躁。我才没有暴躁。

lines.en: This is the best route: keep on the main road until you see Windy Castle up ahead. Thank you, Grandpa Pig.
lines.zh: 这是最好的路线：沿着大路一直走，直到你看见前面的风车城堡。谢谢你，猪爷爷。

lines.en: We follow the main road and look out for Windy Castle. As I thought.
lines.zh: 我们沿着大路走，留意风车城堡。果然不出我所料。

lines.en: Look, is that a castle? Yes, it's Windy Castle!
lines.zh: 看，那是一座城堡吗？是的，那就是风车城堡！

lines.en: Come on, car! Car!
lines.zh: 加油，车子！车子！

lines.en: Peppa and her family have arrived at Windy Castle.
lines.zh: 佩奇一家到达了风车城堡。

lines.en: Wow, it's so tall. Let's go inside. The view from the top is fantastic.
lines.zh: 哇，它好高啊。我们进去吧。从顶上看出去的风景美极了。

lines.en: Look at the view. Mummy, is that Granny and Grandpa's house? Yes, it is. It's so far away.
lines.zh: 快看这风景。妈妈，那是爷爷奶奶家吗？是的。好远啊。

lines.en: Let's take a look through the telescope. Can I look first, please? Yes, but you must let George look next.
lines.zh: 我们用望远镜看看吧。我能第一个看吗？可以，不过你要让乔治接着看。

lines.en: Wow, the telescope makes everything look bigger. I can see Granny and Grandpa. Look, George!
lines.zh: 哇，望远镜把所有东西都放大了。我能看到爷爷和奶奶。乔治你看！

lines.en: George is waving at Granny and Grandpa. Silly George. Granny and Grandpa are too far away to see you waving.
lines.zh: 乔治在朝爷爷奶奶挥手。傻乔治。爷爷奶奶离得太远了，看不见你挥手。

lines.en: I know, we can ring them.
lines.zh: 我知道了，我们可以给他们打电话。

lines.en: Hello, Grandpa Pig. We can see you from Windy Castle. Wave at us!
lines.zh: 喂，猪爷爷。我们从风车城堡能看到你们。朝我们挥挥手吧！
